Solution: If a fraction is simultaneously in the forms and , we must have
5k − 3 4l − 3
7k − 5 6l − 1
= .
5k − 3 4l − 3
This simplifies to kl + 8k + l − 6 = 0. We can write this in the form
(k + 1)(l + 8) = 14.
Now 14 can be factored in 8 ways: 1 × 14, 2 × 7, 7 × 2, 14 × 1, (−1) × (−14), (−2) × (−7),
